before.source:
def fill(self, amount):
    """Add amount if it fits and return 'OK'; return 'FULL' and change
    nothing if it does not."""
    room = self.size - self.level
    if amount > room:
        return 'FULL'
    self.level = self.level + amount
    return 'OK'

def fill(self, amount):
    """Add amount if it fits and return 'OK'; return 'FULL' and change
    nothing if it does not.

    >>> t = Tank(10)
    >>> t.fill(4)
    'OK'
    >>> t.fill(7)
    'FULL'
    >>> t.level
    4
    """
    room = self.size - self.level
    if amount > room:
        return 'FULL'
    self.level = self.level + amount
    return 'OK'
